record.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE isolated WorldSim style05 BRONZE AGE copper smelter station: a squat hand-built earthen clay shaft furnace, thick ochre clay walls, open dark oval top, one small arched fire mouth facing south/viewer with subtle amber embers, short clay tuyere at right, no metal fittings. NO house or roof. Reference images: props.png and scene.png are immutable ink/earth-wash/lighting anchors ONLY; route_i_sheet_1x.png fixes front three-quarter view about 20 degrees down. Upper-left daylight, top and left clearly lighter, right and lower planes darker. Fine warm charcoal-brown outer contour, secondary marks half outer weight (2:1), broad quiet ochre wash, shadow wash on right. At game scale use exactly 3 short clay crack groups and 3 diagonal parallel hatch marks in one right-side shadow group; do not pepper or cross-hatch entire surfaces. Designed for 64px tile; opaque body silhouette target 40px tall and <=50px wide, adult 56px for scale. Standing front three-quarter ~20deg down, substantial front, shallow compressed top, no isometric diamond, no overhead circle. Entire object centered with generous genuinely alpha-zero transparent margin and transparent openings, no ground/shadow patch, no halo, haze, backdrop, checkerboard, labels, text or border. Precise hand-ink natural history plate with restrained earthy tone wash; no pixel art, no photoreal or 3D rendering. Produce large source for downsampling, true RGBA transparency.
record.height_band_reason: New furnace family: 40px target relative to a 56px adult.

anchor_convention: origin top-left; x right; y down; paste at world base minus anchor
review_flags: Inspect raw halo: faint pixels extend beyond opaque bbox plus 2px; no cleanup applied

review.reviewer: Codex native subagent /root/iron; independent of root smelter generation
review.mechanism: vision inspection of both raw images and normalized contact sheet against locked props/scene and adopted pottery bench

pair_consistency.reason: Outer silhouette, fire mouth, tuyere and three principal clay crack groups remain aligned; upper rim, hatching and proportions match. Cold-state fine wash texture differs slightly but is not visible at game scale.

assets.alpha_note: Visual inspection: no background veil, ground island or visible fringe on the sheet; numerical alpha check remains a separate gate.
differences: Raw clay wash has larger mottled patches than the small adopted pottery vessels; at game scale the quiet body and stronger crack lines hold.
assets.reasoning: Squat clay furnace, south fire mouth and side tuyere read clearly as an early metal station. The restrained amber coals establish active state without replacing upper-left daylight.

assets.alpha_note: Visual inspection: no background veil or halo on normalized sheet.
differences: Some raw fine wash texture changes from the lit parent.
assets.reasoning: The cold variant retains the exact furnace identity and removes the ember cue. Scale, lower-front base, ochre wash, dark fine contours and upper-left light remain consistent with the adopted set.
